build_dynamic_roi_head: build a DynamicRoIHead instance with kwargs for Dynamic R-CNN training with adaptive IoU thresholds
run_loss_forward: run the DynamicRoIHead loss forward pass with multi-level features and RPN proposals to compute bbox and mask losses
run_bbox_loss: run the bbox_loss method to perform forward propagation and loss calculation of the bbox head on RoI features
run_update_hyperparameters: run update_hyperparameters to dynamically adjust IoU thresholds and SmoothL1 beta based on training statistics
review_dynamic_roi_head: review the DynamicRoIHead class that extends StandardRoIHead with adaptive IoU threshold and SmoothL1 beta updates
